body: NFL player Savion Williams’ wife says she knew he was different when, on their very first date, he took her DoorDashing so he could save enough money to take her out later that night. The two have been together ever since, eventually tying the knot and welcoming a child together. Williams has since signed a $6. 29 million contract with the Green Bay Packers. :.
